tools.name: triage_jsonl
tools.description: Run Evil Sift on a local JSONL evidence bundle and return a validated DFIR packet with report, findings, detections, audit trail, and execution log.

file.description: Path to a local JSONL evidence file, relative to repo root or absolute.

out_dir.description: Optional output directory for generated artifacts.

inject_fabricated_finding.description: Testing-only flag. Adds a fabricated evidence ID so an agent can demonstrate self-correction when the validator drops it.
